name: 왕자리
wear: Red enamel armor with emerald green eye-shaped temple ornaments that leave both eyes and face fully clear; two short gray sensor-like hair fins; translucent pale dragonfly wing shapes become four narrow divided shoulder-cape panels, red band markings on suit and gray plate edges; slender red tail shape becomes waist sash. No actual insect limbs or handheld equipment.
light: On a misty reedland landing terrace, adult woman facing camera in front three-quarter stance, both empty open hands apart. Entire head boots and narrow cape panels fit the vertical 1024x1536 canvas.
casual: On a private rooftop fashion terrace at luminous blue hour, standing in relaxed contrapposto with one open hand lightly on a broad parapet and the other lifted loosely beside her shoulder. Entire head both hands and shoes, distant skyline, no other figures.

Opaque fully lined scarlet satin structured longline bustier with broad secure straps and gray tailored high-waisted tap shorts, short translucent emerald chiffon capelet fluttering from shoulders; covered chest and pelvis, bare midriff arms and legs, small green dragonfly pendant.

At an empty grassy model-flight field in crisp breezy morning, stepping sideways after launching a small unpowered balsa glider, both open hands apart at chest height, the plain wooden glider visible in distant air. Face turns toward viewer, entire head and running shoes, no people.
Opaque green racerback fitted crop tank, red high-waisted running skort over secure shorts and gray trainers; bare shoulders arms midriff legs, tiny wing-shaped earrings.

At a private clockmaking workbench under warm evening task light, leaning gently toward a plain opened mechanical clock, one hand uses a short fine screwdriver while the other steadies a separate clock rim. Both entire hands clearly attached to forearms, face readable from slightly above.
Opaque gray short-sleeve cropped fitted work shirt with secure open collar and red high-waisted trousers, bare forearms upper chest and narrow midriff; small green hair clasp.
